description.zh: 加速槽所对应的数据集加速挂载点的唯一标识符。
description.en: The unique ID of the accelerated mount target that is associated with the slot.

description.zh: 加速槽所对应的数据集加速实例的唯一标识符。如何获取加速实例ID，请参见[ListInstances](~~467899~~)。
description.en: The unique ID of the dataset acceleration instance to which the slot belongs. For more information, see [ListInstances](~~467899~~).

description.zh: 数据集加速槽名称，支持模糊匹配。
description.en: The name of the dataset acceleration slot. Fuzzy matching is supported.

description.zh:
排列顺序，取值如下：
- Desc： 降序排列。
- Asc： 升序排列。
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- Desc: Descending order.

- Asc: Ascending order.

description.zh: 加速槽列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1。
description.en: The page number of the slot list. The value starts from 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的加速槽数量，默认为10。
description.en: The number of slots to return on each page. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
数据集加速槽所处状态，取值如下：
- Created：已创建。
- Preparing：正在准备资源。
- Loading：正在加载数据。
- Running：正在运行，提供服务。
- Reloading：正在重新加载数据。
- Succeed：成功完成。
- Failed：已失败。
- Stopping：正在停止。
- Stopped：已停止。
description.en:
The status of the dataset acceleration slot. Valid values:

- Created: The slot is created.

- Preparing: Resources are being prepared.

- Loading: Data is being loaded.

- Running: The slot is running and providing services.

- Reloading: Data is being reloaded.

- Succeed: The operation is successful.

- Failed: The operation failed.

- Stopping: The slot is being stopped.

- Stopped: The slot is stopped.

description.zh: 数据集加速槽ID的列表，多个加速槽ID以半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The IDs of the dataset acceleration slots. Separate multiple IDs with a comma (,).

description.zh:
数据集加速槽的数据存储类型，取值如下：
- OSS：OSS文件存储。
- NAS：NAS文件存储。
description.en:
The data storage type of the dataset acceleration slot. Valid values:

- OSS: OSS file storage.

- NAS: NAS file storage.

description.zh: 数据集加速槽的数据存储路径（URI）。
description.en: The data storage path (URI) of the dataset acceleration slot.

title.zh: 获取数据集加速槽列表

descriptions.zh: 请求参数的作用类似于一个过滤器，过滤器为逻辑与（AND）关系。如果某一参数为空，则过滤器不起作用。
descriptions.en: Request parameters act as filters and are combined using a logical AND. If a parameter is left empty, it is ignored.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun paielasticdatasetaccelerator list-slots --slot-ids slot-my1tk3jggooi5u0000,slot-n69468yvjz8d120000,slot-tga4omjrepklkg0000 --instance-ids inst-my1tk3jggooi5u0000 --name acc_instance_slot_1 --storage-type OSS --phase Running --sort-by GmtCreateTime --order Desc --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --endpoint-ids endp-my1tk3jggooi5uwks5 --storage-uri example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun paielasticdatasetaccelerator GET /api/v1/slots --region cn-hangzhou --Order Desc --StorageType OSS --Phase Running --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --EndpointIds 'endp-my1tk3jggooi5uwks5' --SortBy GmtCreateTime --SlotIds 'slot-my1tk3jggooi5u0000,slot-n69468yvjz8d120000,slot-tga4omjrepklkg0000' --StorageUri 'example-string' --InstanceIds 'inst-my1tk3jggooi5u0000' --Name acc_instance_slot_1 --header "Content-Type=application/json"
